dataList.name: Battōjutsu [Kurokumo]
dataList.desc: Turn 3 Start: This unit equips "Battō Shisei" in its Skill Slots и uses it repeatedly during в этом ходу - Said Начало хода: Получает (25 + (недостающего у себя процента ХП) / 2)[SharpSensibility] (округляется вниз) - During said turn, при получении удара один раз на a Sinner's Э.Г.О Skill with 1 base Вес атаки, cancel "Ready to Draw" и Активирует следующие эффекты (each Skill only counts as hitting один раз): · Change [SharpSensibility] to 0 · получает +1 for все Э.Г.О Resource · Получает 5 [Vulnerable] for the на следующий ход; Сила клеша -5 for "Kumogiri" и "Rend Space" - Repeat the above каждые 2 хода. Every time this unit enters this pattern, +1 to the number of hits required to cancel "Ready to Draw" (макс. +3) Начало хода: Если this unit had "Battō Shisei" equipped при last Turn End, использует "Kumogiri" Когда ХП этого юнита drops to 50% или below for the first time в этой битве, immediately заканчивает ход; затем, если there are менее 5 "Kurokumo Clan" allies other than this unit и Jun, Призывает до 5 allies comprised of Adept Kurokumo Henchwoman и Tired Kurokumo Henchwoman. (above units are summoned при 30 IQ) After entering a different pattern, получает следующие эффекты: - Наносит +(недостающего у себя процента ХП)% урона (макс. 100%) - Replace "Kumogiri" with "Rend Space"
dataList.summary:
каждые 2 хода, использует "Battō Shisei" followed на "Kumogiri"

При 50%- ХП, призывает allies и наносит больше урона
dataList.flavor: The Kurokumo Clan owes its signature sword-drawing technique to its very first Patriarch. Keep a wary eye on the bank of black clouds все you like, but you will never predict where the flash of the lightning-fast sword will strike, или когда.

dataList.name: Patriarch of the Third Family, a Kurokumo Clan Subsidiary
dataList.desc: Allied "Kurokumo Clan" units, включая этого юнита, получает 1 [BlackCloudBladeEnemy] for the Encounter - Когда an affected unit's ХП drops 50% или below for the first time в этой битве, additionally получает 1 [EngageToBattleEnemy] Whenever an allied "Kurokumo Clan" unit is defeated, мин. и макс. скорость +1 for Mine, Patriarch of the Kurokumo Clan's Third Family (макс. +5 each)
dataList.flavor:
The Kurokumo Clan's reach extends from the South of the City все the way to the East. Its subsidiaries are many, but only the First through the Fourth have each acquired an identity of their own. In the character of each, one may recognize the hand of its Patriarch.

The First rules the Clan. The Second became its keenest blade. The Third enjoys a good battle of blades и the slaughter that comes with it, going wherever there's plenty of both. As for the Fourth... one day the Fourth simply vanished. To where, no one can say.
